GoodsReceivedNoteItem.name: GoodsReceivedNoteItem
GoodsReceivedNoteItem.description: Represents a single line entry on the Goods Received Note (GRN) that details the receiving status of a specific product. It records the total quantity received and indicates how many units were damaged, short-delivered, or received in excess of the purchase order. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

GoodsReceivedNoteItemNumber.description: A unique identifier for each item in the Goods Received Note.

GoodsReceivedNote.description: The parent Goods Received Note record for this item.

QuantityonInvoice.description: The quantity specified on the supplier’s invoice for this item.

ReceivedQuantity.description: The actual quantity of the item received.

AcceptedQuantity.description: The quantity of the item accepted after inspection.

DamagedQuantity.description: The quantity of the item that was damaged upon receipt.

ShortageQuantity.description: The quantity shortage for this item compared to the order or invoice.

ExcessQuantity.description: The quantity received in excess of what was ordered or invoiced.

UnitofMeasure.description: The unit of measure used to quantify the item.

Product.description: The product associated with this Goods Received Note item.

PurchaseOrderItem.description: The specific item number from the related purchase order.

StatusCode.description: The current status of the item within the Goods Received Note process.

Comments.description: Additional notes or remarks related to this Goods Received Note item.

LastSyncedInvReceivedQty.description: The quantity received during the most recent inventory synchronization.

InvSyncStatus.description: The current status of the inventory synchronization process for this item.

InvSyncMessage.description: Details about the inventory synchronization, such as the reason for a synchronization failure.

ProductItem.description: The product item associated with this Goods Received Note item.
